summary: Research fragments that make the corpus demand the fetch instead of substituting for it: research-source-discipline (the shared block every research role includes — load-bearing definition, URL plus access date, H/M/L confidence, recency, the no-reliable-figure path, the recalled-not-verified label, faion fact add provenance), research-market-analyst (competitor breadth floors and a mandatory debunk pass), research-evidence-table (the output contract, gated by the source-table tool) and research-desk-brief (question to executable search plan). Tier solo so it matches the research tool pack it invokes.
